action: Re-ranked Best Sellers (term 73) against live order volume after the catalogue grew to 167 products

method.signal: lastest_volume from aliexpress.affiliate.productdetail.get, fetched fresh at rank time rather than read from stored values
method.why_capped: An uncapped ranking fills the category with whichever section sells hardest. Leashes and harnesses would have taken most of the slots.

coverage.unranked_reason: productdetail.get returned empty for these across repeated single-ID retries, after roughly 160 detail calls in the same session. All 12 affiliate links were checked directly and every one still 302-redirects to the correct live item, so this is an API limit rather than delisted products. They were excluded from ranking rather than ranked on stale numbers.

seo_title_cleanup.action: Removed the '| Review' framing from every product SEO title and replaced it with '| LookDog'
seo_title_cleanup.why: No product on the site has been physically tested. A title promising a review the page does not contain is an E-E-A-T liability, not a ranking win.
seo_title_cleanup.hand_rewritten_reason: Five had 'Review' embedded mid-title rather than as a trailing suffix, and the rest exceeded 60 characters once the suffix was swapped
seo_title_cleanup.suffix_added_reason: These three never carried the Review suffix and so had no brand suffix at all
seo_title_cleanup.blog_index_page: Post 3280 title and description both advertised reviews the blog does not contain; retitled to 'LookDog Blog | Dog Care Guides and Buying Advice'
seo_title_cleanup.left_alone: Post 3275 (contact page) uses 'review' as a verb in an invitation to suggest topics, which is accurate
seo_title_cleanup.verified_after: 167 of 167 products carry an SEO title, none contains the word review, none exceeds 60 characters, and all end in '| LookDog'
